props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called by SubmitButton or an owned Form. Consumer commits selection.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called by CancelButton. Consumer restores any transactional selection.

props.name: children
props.description: Compose Trigger, Overlay and accessible content in consumer-authored order.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Use defaultOpen for uncontrolled state.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected values, including values outside rendered results.

props.name: focusStrategy
props.description: Active descendant keeps input focus; roving moves DOM focus between options.

props.name: filterValue
props.description: Controlled query. Consumers filter their composed children.
